title: Street waiting and companionship

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Use recognizable street moments so a public-life illustration feels familiar rather than abstract.
strategic_value: A bus shelter, skater and person with a dog can connect Helsinki imagery to everyday travel and companionship.
demonstration: A green bus shelter and timetable anchor the yellow field, with a skater, standing figures, birds and a dog around it.
practical_value: Use the shelter as a contextual anchor while choosing only the figures needed for a message.

content_islands.name: Transit anchor
content_islands.spec: Place the shelter and timetable near the center-left.

content_islands.name: Street figures
content_islands.spec: Distribute the skater, standing people, dog and birds around the shelter.
